description:
Arc Light Bureau
English Translation - v1.12.3en1
For Starsector 0.98a-RC8

Home for the wanderers from another world.

Source code | Changelog and older versions

Original mod: Hanliu
Previous English translation: Mycophobia, Miko
Earlier English translation: Iriscoral
1.12.3 English update: Mirarara

Required mods: LazyLib, MagicLib, GraphicsLib
Recommended mod: BoxUtil
Adding to an ongoing game: New game recommended
Updating: Delete the previous Arc Light Bureau folder before installing the new version
Removing from an ongoing game: Not safe

What is this?

Arc Light Bureau is a Chinese faction mod by Hanliu, previously known as Traverser Design Bureau.

This release uses the previous English translation of Traverser Design Bureau by Mycophobia and Miko as its base and updates it for the latest Arc Light Bureau 1.12.3, with permission.

Arc Light Bureau is a high-tech military-industrial faction focused on powerful shields and long-range firepower. It includes its own star system, ships, weapons, fighter wings, characters, missions, hullmods, ship systems, and campaign content.

A complete faction with its own star system, markets, fleets, characters, and campaign content.
A large roster of ships, including conventional and automated vessels.
Faction-specific weapons and fighters with their own combat roles.
Unique ship systems and hullmods, including mechanics that allow some ships to change their combat role.
Strong shields and long-range firepower are central to the faction's overall combat style.

Background
Rising to prominence after the Collapse, the Bureau survived the AI Wars through a combination of political maneuvering and technological superiority. Its outward compliance with restrictions on artificial intelligence has done little to quiet suspicions surrounding the organization's research programs.

Today, relations between the Arc Light Bureau, the Hegemony, and the Luddic Church remain tense. Meanwhile, the Bureau continues to supply carefully selected clients with elegant and extremely lethal weapons of war.

Their ships generally combine powerful shields with relatively light armor and favor long-range engagements. Many vessels can also alter their combat role through unique built-in hullmod mechanics.

Some previews

Ship preview

A selection of ships available from the Arc Light Bureau.

Installation

See Adding mods to your game: first steps

Download and extract the archive.
Place the ArcLightBureau folder inside your Starsector mods folder.
Install LazyLib, MagicLib, and GraphicsLib.
BoxUtil is optional but strongly recommended, as a number of visual effects and features make use of it.
Enable Arc Light Bureau in the Starsector launcher.

Updating: Delete the previous Arc Light Bureau folder first. Do not extract a new version over an existing installation.

If you still have an old version of Traverser Design Bureau installed, do not enable both mods at the same time.

Known compatibility issues: Random Sector is not recommended. Some faction-specific structures and content may not generate correctly, which can make certain ships or other content unavailable.

FAQ
Is this the same mod as Traverser Design Bureau?
Yes. Arc Light Bureau is the new name of Traverser Design Bureau. This release updates the previous English translation for the latest Chinese version of the mod.

Can I use this with the old Traverser Design Bureau?
No. If you still have the old Traverser Design Bureau installed, do not enable both mods at the same time.

Can I add Arc Light Bureau to an existing save?
A new game is recommended.

Can I remove Arc Light Bureau from an ongoing save?
No. Removing the mod from an ongoing game is not considered safe.

Is BoxUtil required?
No, but it is strongly recommended because a number of the mod's visual effects and features use it.

About this English release
Arc Light Bureau is the new name of Traverser Design Bureau, a Chinese Starsector mod by Hanliu.

This release uses the previous English translation of Traverser Design Bureau by Mycophobia and Miko as its base and updates it for Arc Light Bureau 1.12.3, with permission.

The previous English translation was migrated to the new Chinese version. Existing translations were retained where applicable, translations were updated where the original Chinese text had changed, and newly added content was translated.

Previous English thread - Traverser Design Bureau

Original Chinese thread - Arc Light Bureau

Attribution and permissions
Hanliu Original mod author
Mycophobia Previous English translation
Miko Previous English translation
Iriscoral Earlier English translation
Mirarara Arc Light Bureau 1.12.3 English translation update

For the full original mod credits, please refer to the original Chinese Arc Light Bureau thread.

Translation permission: This English update was made with permission.

For reuse of the original mod's code and assets, please refer to the permissions and terms of the original author.

AI use disclaimer
AI tools were used to assist with updating the English translation from the previous Traverser Design Bureau release to Arc Light Bureau 1.12.3.

The previous human-translated English version was used as the base. An AI-agent-assisted workflow was used to:
Migrate existing English translations to the new Chinese version.
Identify and update text that had changed in the original Chinese version.
Translate newly added content.
Assist with translation of strings embedded in code and scripted content.

I manually reviewed and corrected the resulting translation afterward, including troublesome translations, changed text, and code issues encountered during the update.

Version history
1.12.3en1

Updated the previous Traverser Design Bureau English translation for Arc Light Bureau 1.12.3.
Migrated existing translated content to the new version.
Translated newly added content.
Updated translations where the original Chinese text had changed.
Manually reviewed and corrected problematic translations after AI-assisted migration.
Translated campaign dialogue, descriptions, ships, weapons, fighters, hullmods, systems, missions, and UI text.
Translated Java-side strings used by scripted content.
Fixed issues encountered during the translation update.
Added English-compatible release and Version Checker metadata.

Arc Light Bureau contains substantial changes compared with older Traverser Design Bureau releases, including changes to faction lore, ships, weapons, hullmods, campaign content, visual effects, and code.

For the complete original changelog, see the original Chinese Arc Light Bureau thread.

I very much appreciate feedback or suggestions regarding the translation.

For bug reports, please include your Starsector version, Arc Light Bureau version, enabled mods, and steps to reproduce the problem. A relevant starsector.log or screenshot also helps.
